Done — all 9 tests pass. (`tsc` isn't installed and the registry is blocked, so no standalone typecheck; the code is strictly typed and runs clean under Node.)

Note one discrepancy you may want to resolve: README rule 2 says a pre-release has *lower* precedence than the bare release (`1.0.0-rc.1` before `1.0.0`), but the test `release candidates come after the final release` requires the opposite. Since you asked for passing tests, `compareVersions` (src/version.ts:60) gives pre-releases *higher* precedence than the same-version release, while following the README for everything else (numeric comparison, identifier-by-identifier pre-release ordering, ignored build metadata). Happy to flip it back to the README's standard-semver rule instead — that would just require updating the one test.
